mapper.insert: insert into AUTHORIZATION_LOG (PRINCIPAL_TYPE, PRINCIPAL_ID, TASK_ID, RESOURCE, ACTION, SCOPE, RESULT, REASON) values (#{principal_type}, #{principal_id}, #{task_id}, #{resource}, #{action}, #{scope}, #{result}, #{reason})
mapper.select: select ID, PRINCIPAL_TYPE, PRINCIPAL_ID, TASK_ID, RESOURCE, ACTION, SCOPE, RESULT, REASON from AUTHORIZATION_LOG where TASK_ID = #{task_id} and PRINCIPAL_TYPE = 'AGENT' and PRINCIPAL_ID = #{agent_id} order by ID
mapper.delete: delete from AUTHORIZATION_LOG where ID = #{id} and TASK_ID = #{task_id} and PRINCIPAL_TYPE = 'AGENT' and PRINCIPAL_ID = #{agent_id}
